title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker who recovers on Vryn with his mother, then plots with Vraska to remake the Multiverse and steals Loot from the Fomori vault.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon and Jace's beloved who loses her planeswalker spark after phyresis and plans the heist with him.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother, a healer and field medic who treats Jace and Vraska on Vryn.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young creature taken from the Fomori vault whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath's endpoint.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A frightening figure whose likeness Jace borrows through illusion for the heist.

entities.name: Jace as Ashiok
entities.description: The persona Jace builds, with an illusion of Ashiok, to hire the crew and break out Eriette.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A wicked witch freed from an Eldraine jail by Jace as Ashiok.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin whom Vraska recruits on Ixalan.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren whom Vraska recruits on Ixalan.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A Ravnican detective Jace studies for his ability to project psychic imprints.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: An assassin who is with Proft when Jace stalks him.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: A Golgari figure bargaining with Proft and Etrata.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A dear friend who told Jace the story of the vaults.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The leader of the Infinite Consortium who sent young Jace to the Fomori vault.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who feared what was in the Fomori vault.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A sphinx whom Jace is said to have killed and who erased his memory.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: The planeswalker whose sword left a wound in Jace's chest.

entities.name: Judith of the Rakdos
entities.description: A Rakdos performer whose advice on performance Jace recalls.

entities.name: Pewter
entities.description: The cart-horse that young Jace illusioned a copy of.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, under war and with a warrant for his execution.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane where the Fomori vault stands and where Jace and Vraska meet with Loot.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where Jace frees Eriette.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane with the floating city of High and Dry where Vraska recruits Breeches and Malcolm.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Jace stalks Proft in the Golgari undercity.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane Loot knows how to reach, where there is cold coffee.

entities.name: Fomori vault
entities.description: A vault on Thunder Junction, one of several relics of an ancient empire, which Jace once approached.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Portals between planes that Jace and Vraska see as dangerous.

entities.name: Phoenix feather
entities.description: A healing feather Ranna uses to restore Vraska, which inspires Jace and Vraska's plan of rebirth.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: The artifact whose power Jace still feels in his nerves.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: The Phyrexian transformation that Jace and Vraska fight off.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Tezzeret's organization.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The former group of planeswalker heroes of which Jace and Vraska are former associates.

events.summary: On Vryn, Ranna Beleren tends to Jace and Vraska, who arrive bleeding on her floor; Vraska asks her to save Jace first.
events.quote: "Save him first," Vraska rasps

events.summary: Ranna telepathically asks whether Vraska is Jace's wife, and Jace answers that she is his world.
events.quote: She is my world, mother.

events.summary: Ranna casts a ward and sedates the pair with a song.
events.quote: Ranna whispers to them both a song of sedation

events.summary: Jace wakes in his old bedroom and explains he gave them fevers to burn out phyresis; Ranna reveals Vryn thought he died with Alhammarret.
events.quote: We all thought you died with him.

events.summary: Jace shows his mother his memories, and she asks if he killed Alhammarret; his expression answers yes.
events.quote: Ranna nods for him. " Good ."

events.summary: Ranna uses a phoenix feather to heal Vraska, and Jace learns his parents separated.
events.quote: It's a phoenix feather.

events.summary: Jace overhears Ranna telling Vraska that the old her is dead, mentioning a warrant for Jace's execution.
events.quote: The old you is dead. You can never be that person ever again.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska, disguised, visit an Omenpath on Vryn and decide something must be done about the portals.
events.quote: "Jace. We have to do something."

events.summary: Jace and Vraska decide the Multiverse is too broken to fix and settle on a rebirth plan inspired by phoenix feathers.
events.quote: "So, what if we do something other than fix it."

events.summary: Over months they accept their old lives are over and agree that rebirth is the just option.
events.quote: But rebirth … rebirth does both.

events.summary: Nine years earlier, young Jace is sent by Tezzeret to the Fomori vault and senses a childlike mind within.
events.quote: he feels a mind deep within the vault, sleepy with torpor, childlike and quiet.

events.summary: Two years earlier, Tamiyo offers to tell Jace the story of the vaults, relics of an ancient empire.
events.quote: Relics of an ancient empire long lost to history.

events.summary: Before leaving Vryn, Jace and Ranna say goodbye and promise weekly contact.
events.quote: "Once a week," Ranna says

events.summary: Vraska discovers she can no longer planeswalk, and Jace confirms her spark is gone.
events.quote: "I can't feel it. I can't feel it anymore."

events.summary: Jace vows to make meaning of their own; Vraska plots their plan on the wall.
events.quote: She turns her grief into purpose with furious alchemy

events.summary: Twelve months earlier, Jace wears an illusion of Ashiok to break Eriette out of a jail on Eldraine.
events.quote: Jace as Ashiok smiles without eyes and curls his fingers around the bars of her cell.

events.summary: Six months earlier, Vraska recruits Breeches and Malcolm in High and Dry.
events.quote: "Hello, boys. You sound like you need a job."

events.summary: A month earlier, Jace baits and knocks down Proft on Ravnica to link minds with him.
events.quote: Jace turns, swings the pipe as best he can, and feels satisfying contact as he knocks Proft to the ground.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska reunite with the prize, a toddler-like child from the Fomori vault.
events.quote: The boy (Tamiyo's text said it was a boy) seems all too happy to take in the world around them.

events.summary: Jace reads the child's mind and learns his name is Loot.
events.quote: "His name is Loot."

events.summary: Jace sees that Loot's mind holds a map of the entire Multiverse and every Omenpath endpoint.
events.quote: It's the way to get from every point to every point.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska promise to protect Loot as their ward.
events.quote: Vraska and I will protect you with all of our strength.

events.summary: The three plan to walk through an Omenpath into the Multiverse, resolved that theirs will be better.
events.quote: Ours will be better.

relations.note: Jace and Vraska are partners and plan a life together.
relations.quote: there is meaning in the clasp of their hands.

relations.note: They conspire together on the heist.
relations.quote: The telepath and the gorgon dream of phoenix feathers.

relations.note: Ranna asks if Jace killed Alhammarret and his expression darkens in answer.
Tezzeret sent young Jace to the Fomori vault.
relations.quote: Tezzeret sent him here to find something the great dragon Nicol Bolas was afraid of.
Vraska carries him now, roly-poly as a toddler

relations.note: Breeches and Malcolm greet Vraska as their captain with happy tears.
relations.quote: Their response is enthusiastic, brimming with happy tears

relations.note: Jace wears an illusion of Ashiok's likeness.
relations.quote: this won't be the last time he wears this face.
